transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well, for the past year or so, I just feel like I’m always puttering around. I'm constantly fixing things, arranging stuff around the house, or volunteering for just one more thing. You'd think I would slow down, but even at 87, I just have a really hard time sitting down and being still. So, that's really what brings me in today.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep than usual to feel fully rested?

No, not really. I still sleep about the same as I always have. I mean, I might be moving around and busy all day, but when night comes, I definitely still need my regular amount of sleep to feel rested. I haven't noticed needing any less of it.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about everyday things?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I have normal concerns like anyone else, but I don't sit around fretting over every little thing. It's really just the physical moving around. I'm not particularly anxious or worried about everyday stuff, I just can't seem to stop puttering.
Do you feel any uncomfortable or unpleasant sensations in your legs when you are resting or sitting still?

No, I don't have anything like that. My legs feel perfectly fine when I sit down. There's no aches or strange, creepy feelings in them at all. It's really just... I just feel like I need to get back up and keep busy, but it's not because my legs are uncomfortable.
Have you or anyone close to you noticed any changes or difficulties with your memory?

No, my memory is still quite sharp, thankfully. I mean, at my age, you might forget a minor detail here or there, but... no, I haven't had any real difficulties. My family hasn't pointed anything out, either. I remember things just fine.
